subject: Data Engineering
title: Loading Into Warehouses
description: A short lesson to help you apply Loading Into Warehouses.

hook.text: The data is clean and transformed. Now it needs a home where analysts can query it fast.

buildup.text: Data warehouses like Snowflake, BigQuery, and Redshift are optimized for analytical queries.

discovery.text: Loading strategies include full refresh, incremental append, and merge-upsert patterns.

twist.text: A bad load strategy can lock tables, slow queries, and frustrate every analyst in the company.

climax.text: Merge-upsert is often the sweet spot: insert new rows, update changed ones, skip duplicates.

punchline.text: Load smart. Analysts will thank you with fewer tickets.

quiz.question: What does a merge-upsert load strategy do?
options: Inserts new rows and updates existing ones
Deletes all data and reloads from scratch
